name: Gilford (United States)
description: The Guilford Courthouse Flag: thirteen stripes of red and blue with a large white canton bearing thirteen blue eight-pointed stars.
history: Gilford is a town in Belknap County, New Hampshire. The flag was adopted on 8 March 2022 (adopted as the town's first official flag by Article 26 of the annual town election of 8 March 2022, in recognition of its long-standing unofficial use and of the 1781 Battle of Guilford Courthouse from which the town takes its name, according to Flags of the World).
